Fetched with npm pack --ignore-scripts, with no dependency installation. Only the self-contained browser UMD and license are shipped. Runtime API is ColorThief.getColorSync/getPaletteSync; it is not the old v2 constructor API. The optional Node sharp peer and Node CLI are not shipped or used. No CDN or external API is called.

The repository HEAD inspected for discovery was a19bce8570322ca619df1f3cae6e0d6efd446639, but that HEAD is not the npm runtime gitHead; they are deliberately recorded separately.

Chinese interface, file validation, sampling and PNG/JSON exports are implemented by Lifeisgood. Source review and local testing do not constitute a full supply-chain or professional color-management audit.
